title: Piping & Instrumentation Diagram Register - LV-6701
content:
PIPING & INSTRUMENTATION DIAGRAM (P&ID) REGISTER: LV-6701 (SEPARATOR LEVEL CONTROL VALVE).
Document No: TJC-LLD-PID-6701, Title: P&ID: LP SEPARATOR SYSTEM (FA-6710 & LV-6701).
Area: 6700 – Product Separation, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-6700-01.
INSTRUMENT & PROCESS CONTROL LOOPS:
- LIC-6701: Level Indicator Controller (Level Controller). Function: Mengontrol bukaan LV-6701. Location: FA-6710 / LV-6701 loop. Interlock: —
- LSHH-6710: Separator level HIGH-HIGH switch (Level Switch) [Setpoint: > 85 %]. Function: Cause T1 / EFF-1 (Open LV-6701 fully). Location: FA-6710 (LP Separator). Interlock: T1/EFF-1
- LSLL-6710: Separator level LOW-LOW switch (Level Switch) [Setpoint: < 15 %]. Function: Cause T2 / EFF-2 (Close LV-6701) & EFF-4 (DCS Alarm). Location: FA-6710 (LP Separator). Interlock: T2/EFF-2/EFF-4
- HS-6701: ESD manual switch (Hand Switch). Function: Cause T3 / EFF-3 (Vent actuator). Location: Control Panel / Field. Interlock: T3/EFF-3
- PSL-6702: Instrument air pressure LOW switch (Pressure Switch) [Setpoint: < 1.0 barg]. Function: Cause T4 / EFF-3 (Vent actuator) & EFF-4 (DCS Alarm). Location: 3" IA-6702 line. Interlock: T4/EFF-3/EFF-4
- PI-6702: Instrument air pressure indicator (Pressure Indicator). Function: Permissive P1 (PI-6702 > 1.2 barg). Location: 3" IA-6702 line. Interlock: P1
- FIC-6702: Flow Indicator Controller (Flow Controller). Function: Flow control on inlet line. Location: Inlet FA-6710 (6" HC line). Interlock: —
- TIC-6702: Temperature Indicator Controller (Temp Controller). Function: Temperature control. Location: Overhead line / FA-6710. Interlock: —
- TB-6702: Temperature Block/Element (Temp Element). Function: Temperature measurement. Location: Bottoms line. Interlock: —
- DVC6200: Digital Valve Controller (Positioner). Function: Permissive P2 (Positioner healthy) / Hart communicator port. Location: Di badan LV-6701. Interlock: P2
- HV-6701: Manual bypass valve (Hand Valve). Function: Permissive P3 (Bypass closed). Location: Bypass line. Interlock: P3
- XV-6701: ESD Solenoid Valve (Solenoid Valve). Function: Mengeksekusi logic Trip dengan cara membuang angin (venting actuator). Location: Sistem pneumatic LV-6701. Interlock: —
CROSS REFERENCES: Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-LV-6701, Interlock: SEQ-6701 (SIL 1).
